reviewSamples.author: Photo of Григорий Малолетков
reviewSamples.text: I’ve been bringing my dog here for a long time and I’m very happy. The team is wonderful and truly loves animals. I have a large, challenging dog, and they handle him with ease. He always comes back looking great and happy. Highly recommend!
